title: franela/goreq
notes: goreq.Request{Uri}.Do() on goreq's shared client. Its shared transport keeps two idle connections per host by default, so MaxIdleConnsPerHost is set to the number of lanes, as for net/http. The body is decoded by goreq's Body.FromJsonTo (encoding/json) into an untyped value. The module has had no release since 2017 (a pseudo-version). The body is the fixture's prepared text (a string body is sent as it is) with ContentType application/json.
